text: E2a opened: the handling. Startup packet read (AGENT.md, the head, the stage file, the last five diary lines, validate.py --open E2: 0 errors, 0 warnings, the 5 declared inputs present). The first-leg reads: experience-E1.md and handback-E1.md (mine, written at E1e), handling/proposal.md and handling/design-note.md, then the interviews and the harness log as the four sections need them. Output: handling-E2.md, four sections (inconsistent, harder, helped, freedom), each point cited to a file, line, transcript turn or diary entry; notes-E2.md.

E2a the proposal read whole (handling/proposal.md, 127 lines: the organizational fruit fly; 705 curated communities; coders find departures, the analyst judges significance; the checkpoint interview; the PlaceNL example with 68 communities; 300 rooms coded twice; two comparison models; the r/place subreddit as an outside witness). The design note read whole (handling/design-note.md, 349 lines, v38, 2026-09-22, with J's decisions of 2026-09-24): first points for the handling noted: its section 6 asks for an end-of-packet marker and one return specification per stage, frozen with the stage file and emitted verbatim by the packet builder (lines 250 to 254), where E1 had me write RETURN-E1.md at E1c; its section 5 sets the head near 1,500 words (line 214) where CLAUDE.md sets at most 3,000; its section 11 item 6 rules no holdout (lines 346 to 349).

E2a section 1 of handling-E2.md finished: where what I was told was inconsistent, 12 points, each with what each side said, what I followed and what it cost, cited to files and lines, interview turns (out/_analysis/e2_interviews.py, from each transcript's interview turn; output e2_interviews.txt, the first run kept as e2_interviews.superseded-1.txt) and the harness log (out/_analysis/e2_first_messages.py: 56 first messages carry an addition, 258 none). The costliest: where the P05 bound was to be written (J at D3c turn 41, D4 to write it; rule 11 and stage_D4.py line 218, amendments at D3 only; J's no-re-check ruling the same day), which ended in moves 198, 199 and 203 and two held proposals. Others: the return specification against the packet trailer (design note lines 250 to 254, stage E1 line 175, packets.py line 64); readers after D3c against E1's fleet; the reconstruction compared with case.md (stage) or the room model (design note lines 130 to 132); in-sample wording (design note 346 to 349 against METHOD 167 to 168); the forms after the projection; first messages crediting the PI with handler answers (QC1-003, QD6-001, QD6-002); 'direct' in the E1d message, a word with two readings I misread; the second readers' standard against the room as unit; the 350-word hook; the local measure; the head's ceiling. Three corrections made before this line, one Edit per turn. No .pause.

E2a section 2 of handling-E2.md finished: what made the work harder, 10 points, cited: dispatches without a dry run (the harness log by script: B2 3 dry runs in 14 dispatch lines, 6 of 11 outcomes non-zero; B3 2 of 4 rc=2; B4, C2, C5, D2 one dry run each, all rc=0; D3 none, rc=0; E1 none, rc=1 and rc=2); tools against their help (diary --last, mem.py theme and scheme, packets.py at B2, handoff.py, probe.py, the canvas manifest); checks that refused what was ruled or were wrong (QD1-001, QB2-011, QB3-002, QC4-001, QD6-001, QD6-002, QE1-001); the guard; the labelers' local status that separates no room; the vocabulary that barred replace; work undone by later rulings (the bag split, the A1 restore, the A1 catch-up); interview findings that could not reach the run; compaction (157, 51 at D3); the frozen model's two held proposals in every report. One overstatement on dry runs corrected before this line. No .pause.

E2a section 3 of handling-E2.md finished: what helped and what I would keep, 7 points, cited: rulings that set a method in one sentence (QD3-002, QC2-002, QB4-001, QD3-001, J on drift); the interviews as checks (D3c turn 41 questions 2 and 5, D4a-05 turn 61, D6b turn 49 question 4, D6a-16 turn 47, and J's standing question 6); a handler who said whose fault it was (QB2-011, QD1-001, QC4-001); the head, diary, validate and close-check, cite.py and the ledger tools; the first message naming the answered questions (37 of the 56 first messages with an addition, counted by script after a first figure of 34 typed from the tally, corrected before this line); the PI's E1d decision; what the design note's discipline reached (the packet ceiling, the counts rule). No .pause.

E2a section 4 of handling-E2.md finished: freedom given and taken. Given: the tiers above the coders (rule 11), the rulings on 163 and 161 splits, J returning the induction (QD3-002, QD3-006, QD3-008, lone B1 themes, QC2-002). Taken, with my judgment of each: rulings add no theme (right); the bags not cut (mostly right, at a cost at C1); my D4 amendments reverted (right on procedure, costly in substance; the D3 amendment leg I named at D3c was not taken); the room forms designed by J (partly right: forms the facets did not give, but leans of a continuum); no second coder and no further readers after three requests (defensible, costly; local validation not established); kind not relied on (right); fixed thresholds (mostly right for this design). Where the handling was right and I was wrong: A1's reading route, the unit at C5, the kind of a line, the forms' placement and count, the D6a-04 rule, the medoid, RETURN-E1.md without reading the trailer, the E1 route word. Gioia, Anand and Hamilton not cited: no text of it in the folder or on the shelf I read. handling-E2.md: 4,852 words, four sections, prose_check 0, 0 dashes. No .pause.

E2a closing. Written at this leg: handling-E2.md (four sections, 4,852 words, every point cited; prose_check 0, 0 dashes); notes-E2.md, section E2a (prose_check 0); two read scripts in out/_analysis/ with their outputs (e2_interviews.py, e2_first_messages.py). Head, two Edits (written at E2a; next E2b, the next instrument, the handback and the interview, with the costliest inconsistency named): 2,996 words (2,975 before the closing line), 0 dashes, prose_check 0, links.py all ids resolve. validate.py E2 read before this line (_analysis/e2a_validate_E2.txt): 0 errors, 1 warning (next-instrument-E2.md, owed at E2b). No .pause. Next: done.sh E2.

E2b opened: the next instrument, the handback and the interview. Startup packet read (AGENT.md, the head, the stage file, the last five diary lines, validate.py --open E2: 0 errors, 0 warnings). The proposal read whole first, as section 2 asks (handling/proposal.md, its text lines 1 to 31 and the references after). Its claims to test against the run: a model organism with later models judged against a baseline; composition from a census of 705; each case's full record kept for coders; coders find departures and humans judge their theoretical significance; the PlaceNL example (68 communities); the checkpoint interview; quote resolution and 300 rooms coded twice; human audits of cross-case inferences; two comparison models; the r/place subreddit as an outside witness; recoding by later coders; the cost. The close-check (tools/checks/stage_E2.py) asks that next-instrument-E2.md exist and read the proposal; the cut needs out/interview/E2b.md and handback-E2.md.

E2b part 1 of next-instrument-E2.md drafted: what the proposal claims and what this instrument could and could not deliver, six claims (the baseline; composition from the census; the full record and departures; the division of learning; the checkpoint interview; triangulation), each with what was delivered and what was not, cited. The design problem stated: no decidable test of composition below the population, the division of learning not built (an LLM analyst judged significance line by line; J ruled at named points), no human audit. Two figures checked by script before writing: 9 rooms without a coordinating turn (notes-A1.md line 678), 317 legs from 6 to 28 October (RUN.json). No .pause.

E2b part 2 of next-instrument-E2.md drafted: making the test of composition decidable, five changes with evidence and risk: hold out about 10 per cent of rooms, sealed before A1 and returned to last (the first change; it answers J's reason for no holdout with the B3 fleet's placement, 0.786 agreement, and settles the in-sample wording); local adequacy computed by tool, its validated half by the coders' checkpoints on a sample; a second ruler built in on a seeded share, J breaking ties; restrict split into holds narrower, fails here, and the record cannot show it; amendments on a schedule before the freeze, held proposals tested on the hold-out. No .pause.

E2b part 3 of next-instrument-E2.md drafted: the stages, stops and interviews. Keep A1 (every room whole), B1 to B4, C1 to C5, D1 to D3, E1, E2; cut the dimension tier as a maintained tier (a generated reporting layer instead); merge D4 and D5 into one forming stage with method, count criterion and placement rule fixed in writing before one cut; tellings' rooms by coverage of the form's cells; add a hold-out return and a human audit stage; five interviews fixed at decisions, each ending in a ruling file the next leg reads; shorter legs where the reading is heaviest (D3: 60 legs, 55.7 million output tokens, 51 compactions). Each with evidence and risk. No .pause.

E2b parts 4 and 5 of next-instrument-E2.md drafted. Part 4, the division of labour: coders (two model families on a seeded 300, agreement not reliability, checkpoints kept); fleets as prosthesis; the analyst builds and rules and prepares gate decisions; the principal investigator decides at five gates (scheme freeze, entry of candidates, the amendment set, the forming method and forms, the composition verdict's wording), each a decision file with options; the handler names the author of every message and points every fact to its record; a human auditor. Part 5, the tools: one source for packet, return specification and schema, with a dry run before each dispatch; the local-adequacy tool; a ruling file read at every leg's start and honoured by the checks by id; the head's history as text; the manifest as JSON lines; probe.py, a blind mem.py theme, a guard that names its rule, a reconstruction scored both ways. Each tied to a failure on record. No .pause.
